name: トランプ兵
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one vertical 3:4 illustration for a Tottery game card. Image 1 is the design identity reference; image 2 is STYLE ONLY. Match image 2's mature anime fantasy, crisp outlines, angular cel shading, broad clean color shapes, deep navy flat backdrop and restrained antique gold accents. Preserve image 1's design and colors but simplify fine decoration for readability at 48px. No photorealism, no scenic background, no card frame, no numbers, no rank, no typography, no watermark. Show the original heart playing-card soldier from image 1 in a tight helmet-and-upper-torso portrait. Include the closed dark-steel helmet and ruby heart crest, burgundy scarf, ivory rectangular card armor with large red heart, gold edging and one heart-tipped polearm beside the shoulder. Strong graphic silhouette. Armor and heart occupy lower half; helmet large in upper half. No human face, do not copy the Hatter.
